name: Gluta White Face Wash | Deep Cleansing Brightening Oil Control Gentle Daily Cleanser
description:
The Gluta White Face Wash provides deep cleansing while promoting a bright and glowing complexion. Its gentle yet effective formula removes dirt, oil, and impurities without stripping skin moisture. Designed for daily use, it also helps exfoliate dead skin cells, leaving your skin fresh, smooth, and radiant. Suitable for all skin types, this cleanser is ideal for both morning and night routines.
Key Features
 Deeply cleanses pores and removes impurities
 Controls excess oil and prevents buildup
 Promotes brighter, radiant-looking skin
 Gentle exfoliation for smooth texture
 Provides long-lasting freshness after every wash
 Suitable for daily morning and night use
Ingredients / Materials
Skin-safe cleansing agents with brightening and oil-control properties (formulation details vary)
How to Use
 Wet face with lukewarm water
 Apply a small amount and lather in palms
 Massage onto face in circular motions
 Focus on oily or pigmented areas
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best results
Package Includes
 1 × Gluta White Face Wash
